extensionName.message: CHINE — Chrome HTTP Is Not Emulated

extensionDescription.message: A Firefox-only HTTPS-first extension with local upgrade failure records.

forceHttps.message: Force HTTPS upgrade for HTTP pages

tempContainer.message: Open chosen HTTP fallbacks in a temporary container

containerNote.message: Separates cookies and site data. This is not a full security sandbox. Firefox Container Tabs must be enabled.

mixedContent.message: Add mixed content upgrade CSP policy to HTTPS pages

upgradeNote.message: Upgrade failures are recorded for display. CHINE never uses a record to downgrade automatically.

statPersistence.message: Stored locally; persists across browser restarts until reset.

failureListNote.message: Records expire after 30 days. A record does not mean a site is HTTP-only.

containerIsolationNote.message: When selected, HTTP fallback tabs use a Firefox container to separate cookies and site data. Containers are not full security sandboxes.

aboutText.message: Firefox-only extension. Prioritizes HTTPS and minimizes exposure to unencrypted traffic. It does not guarantee that every mixed content resource is upgraded.

openSourceText.message: Open-source software under the MIT License.

containerApiUnavailable.message: Firefox's container API is unavailable. Enable Container Tabs in Firefox settings (about:config: privacy.userContext.enabled) and reload CHINE.

containerCreateFailed.message: Firefox could not create a temporary container. Container Tabs may be disabled; check about:config and set privacy.userContext.enabled to true. No HTTP tab was opened.

containerTabFailed.message: Firefox created the temporary container but could not open its tab. No HTTP fallback was opened.

fallbackOpenFailed.message: Could not open the HTTP fallback.

localPolicy.message: HTTP upgrade is skipped for localhost, .local, single-label hosts, and private or loopback IP ranges.
